threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 106 bus is a reliable option. Just wait till a Saturday night and you’ll wish you booked a cab instead.
On the N37 last night, a fella serenaded us with 90s R&B, while an old woman argued with her reflection in the window. London nights, eh?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: One night, I stumbled upon a late-night karaoke on Hermannstraße. Everyone was singing in different languages, and the vibe felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar that serves cocktails with currywurst-infused vodka. It's like Berlin's nightlife handed you a taste of home.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they instinctively duck under that low overhang at 16th and Mission—most just walk right into it.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Spotted a guy juggling on the 14 bus during a breakdown. He got a standing ovation when the driver finally announced a delay. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals go to Plaça del Sol for a drink, but the real hidden gems are the tiny bars down the side streets where the tapas flow.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always ask for 'tapas' but end up ordering pizza—clue #1 that they're still in tourist mode.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'bus stop' instead of a 'bus shelter' like everyone else around here. The locals know, it’s the little things that matter.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham last weekend; the driver serenaded us with classic Motown all the way. Best ride of the night!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Last Sunday, I saw a guy in a pink suit juggling flaming torches while his dog waited patiently for a hot dog. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a Döner spot that serves vegan kebabs at 3 AM, buzzing with late-night debates about art and politics.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their nonchalance when BART's a mess; tourists freak out while we just roll our eyes and grab a burrito.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 38 Geary at 5 PM—door wouldn’t close, driver just shrugged. We sat for 10 mins while tourists took selfies in the chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all trendy bars, but on any given morning, our quiet plazas echo with locals’ morning chats over cafés, not cocktails.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion at the multi-stop, forever-spiraling route of the 24 bus - they think it's a shortcut.
